notes: No Clearance/Outlet/Final-Sale/Last-Chance/End-of-Line labeled page exists anywhere on 2modern.com. Evidence of thoroughness: (1) checked main desktop nav and mobile nav in full - the only discount-themed nav item anywhere on the site is a top-level 'Sale' item (data-handle=sale) linking to /collections/on-sale, plus a promo announcement-bar banner 'Last Call: Labor Day Sale' linking to /pages/labor-day-sale (a named seasonal campaign page, rendered with the collection template but explicitly tied to the Labor Day holiday - excluded as a temporary promotional campaign, not a permanent clearance/outlet concept); (2) grepped the full sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml + sitemap_collections_2.xml (2879 total collection URLs) for clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line - zero matches of any kind, confirming this is a genuine absence and not a false negative from an incomplete nav read; (3) per the brief's instruction to also try internal site search for unlinked Clearance-type pages, queried both the on-site /search?q=clearance and /search?q=outlet pages (no redirect, HTTP 200, same URL) and the underlying Searchspring search.json API directly with q=clearance and q=outlet - both returned totalResults=1 with no merchandising.redirect set and no triggered non-global campaign, i.e. a single fuzzy/near-miss product match, not a hidden clearance collection. CLOSEST CANDIDATE, recorded per the brief's 'when uncertain, record with a flag rather than guess' instruction: /collections/on-sale. The site's OWN taxonomy labels this 'Sale', not Clearance/Outlet - nav data-handle='sale', page <title> 'Modern Furniture, Lighting & Decor on Sale', og:title 'All Designs on Sale'. No clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line wording appears anywhere on the page itself. It is contextually linked to the Labor Day promotional banner elsewhere on the same homepage, which leans toward this being (or at least overlapping with) a temporary seasonal-campaign-style sale rather than a permanent markdown/outlet merchandising concept - on balance this leans NOT-Clearance, but it is recorded rather than silently dropped because it is the single closest candidate on the entire site and a human reviewer may weigh the permanence signal differently. The 'Sale' nav item has ~15 department/sub-department 'on sale' re-cuts (Furniture/Living Room/Dining Room/Bedroom/Office/Lighting/Pendants/Chandeliers/Table Lamps/Floor Lamps/Wall Lights/Outdoor/Rugs/Decor/Tabletop/Planters on Sale) nested under it in the mega-menu; these were not separately enumerated as additional rows since the root 'Sale' concept itself is already flagged ambiguous/leaning-exclude - multiplying the same ambiguity across ~15 rows seemed less useful than one clearly-flagged parent row plus this note. No robots.txt Claude-disallow; no WAF; all access via tier-1 direct HTTP fetch + Searchspring API, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed.
